build.overlap: Same precompiled Hermes -O bytecode on all hosts

clock: __now when available; otherwise Date.now. Calibration >=50ms, median of seven samples.
order: Three complete 33-case invocations per host. Rounds 1 and 3 before/after/magrinj; round 2 reverses. No builds or profiling during timings.
outputChecks: 297 values checked. All FormatJS before/after values match. Only comparator differences: omitted/unsupported ListFormat default locale en-US versus en.
change: Each immutable RTF locale pack reuses at most 64 NumberFormat plans, keyed by resolved locale and numbering system. Total key lengths above 128 bytes bypass admission. Public receivers and options remain independent, getters/validation still run, new packs have fresh caches, formatting takes no cache lock.

conformance.gates: Ten targeted Rust, TS/Rust, Hermes source/bytecode, Test262, bridge and pinned ICU4C/J/X checks pass.
conformance.independentMatrix: 19,008 ICU4X relative-time outputs checked: 12 locales, three numbering-system selections, all three styles, both numeric modes, all eight units, 11 numeric values.
conformance.differences: 1,440 ICU4X separator differences pinned individually. ICU4C 78.1 and ICU4J 78.1 independently verify every preferred output. NumberFormat grouping auto and 0-3 fraction digits configured explicitly, matching ECMA-402 internal number options.
conformance.mutation: Omitting numbering-system key makes test fail: Latin 3 days ago instead of Arabic digits.
conformance.consumer: Nine SDK API smoke scripts pass.

limits: RTF construction still trails optimized magrinj. Several steady-state API gaps remain. No whole-goal completion claim.

commands.benchmark: bazel build -c opt //benchmarks/hermes-intl-extension:overlap_bytecode; run cquery artifact on each pinned optimized host
